text:
alex_sales: BetaSoft POC flapping under load. Getting mixed 401s and 403s during chat load tests. Demo scheduled Friday, need triage.

devon_se: Which endpoint and headers? Any sample curl/logs?

alex_sales: They POST to /v1/chat with Authorization: Bearer sk-bs-zzzz and x-project-id: beta-prod-us. Intermittent 401 then 403 with 'binding_not_found'.

sergio_support: Paste raw response bodies if you have them.

alex_sales: From their logs:
```json
{"error":"Unauthorized","reason":"invalid_key","request_id":"rz-xx12","hint":"maybe key revoked"}
```
and later:
```json
{"error":"Forbidden","reason":"binding_not_found","details":"no matching project binding for header 'beta-prod-us'","request_id":"rz-xx13"}
```

lina_ps: Customer rotates keys between staging/prod and injects x-project-id via k8s Downward API. Sometimes suffixes vary.

meera_eng: Likely causes: (1) token claim project == 'beta-prod' while header is 'beta-prod-us' -> mismatch; (2) some rotated keys are legacy and lack new required scope 'inference:chat', causing 401 when hitting scope-guarded endpoints.

devon_se: Ask them to try the request without x-project-id header to confirm token binding. Also decode JWT to inspect 'project' and 'scopes' claims.

meera_eng: Quick decode snippet to share:
```bash
# decode JWT payload
echo 'eyJhbGciOi...' | cut -d'.' -f2 | base64 --decode | jq
```
Look for "project" and "scopes".

sergio_support: Short-term fixes: issue a temporary demo key bound to 'beta-prod-us' with scope inference:chat and TTL 48h, or have them update the header to match the key binding. I can provision the key once PS approves.

alex_sales: They asked if temporary keys affect billing or entitlements.

lina_ps: No billing change for short demo keys. If they need sustained higher throughput we can bump quota for the trial; I'll file an internal request for a 72h quota bump if needed.

meera_eng: FYI we deployed a stricter project-binding validation yesterday which rejects unknown suffixes. Log snippet:
```
level=warn component=proj-bind-check req=rz-xx13 msg=\"no binding match\" expected=beta-prod header=beta-prod-us
```
We debated normalizing suffixes but that could accidentally route across tenants. Planning an alias-table behind a feature flag.

ci-bot: ci: canary deploy proj-binding-v3 to staging at 2025-04-12T09:03:00Z (pipeline #8245)

meera_eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood/project-bindings/pull/802 adds alias map + feature flag + extra debug logs. Will monitor staging metrics.

sergio_support: Created support ticket #4721 with attachments (curl samples, logs) and assigned to eng-infra. Also issued temp key id bs-temp-48h (scope: inference:chat, binding: beta-prod-us) TTL 48h and emailed contact.

alex_sales: Can you give step-by-step for non-technical ops folks to verify key in console?

sergio_support: Sent email with steps: 1) Console -> Keys -> find key -> check Binding and Scopes fields; 2) Try curl without x-project-id; 3) If still failing, paste response body + request_id in the ticket.

lina_ps: I'll annotate the security questionnaire: demo key short-lived, scoped to inference:chat, not allowed for billing changes.

devon_se: Can engineering confirm behavior differences between legacy keys and new scoped keys so we can explain 401 vs 403 to the customer?

meera_eng: Legacy keys without explicit scopes return 401 when calling scope-protected endpoints. Header/token mismatches return 403 with binding reason. We'll add a short KB blurb describing both failure modes.

alex_sales: Thanks. I'll coordinate with BetaSoft and share the temp key and steps. Please update ticket #4721 and post here when PR toggles or ticket progresses.

sergio_support: Monitoring request ids rz-xx12 and rz-xx13 in logs and will update the ticket.

meera_eng: Watching staging for alias-map errors; will report back by EOD.

alex_sales: Closing once BetaSoft confirms demo is green. Appreciate the help.
